load_model_from_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model and weights from a checkpoint file path using the fairchem registry
match_state_dict_keys: match model state dict keys with checkpoint state dict to handle DataParallel module prefix differences
setup_fairchem_imports: setup and import all fairchem core modules including trainers datasets models and tasks from the project root
get_tensor_statistics: compute max min std mean norm and nonzero fraction statistics for a PyTorch tensor
get_model_weight_table: generate a table of all model parameters with their shapes weight stats and gradient stats
